summary: An A-list actor who rarely does variety shows, and the thread treats the booking itself as the achievement — several commenters say he never appears on programmes and credit the channel's access. The largest cluster is straightforwardly about his looks and screen presence, described as star aura that only intensifies when he steps out of the car. The second is the hosts' visible flustering, especially Dream going red-faced, which viewers name as the reason the episode works. The third is a chain of adjacent requests: if he came, then his co-star, his partner, and the other actors of that tier must be possible too, each with a call to upvote. Sentiment is almost entirely positive with no criticism at all.
